name: Files Helper
desc: Read, create, convert, check, zip and unzip files in your flow.

actions.name: read_file
actions.description: Return a file's contents as text or Base64.

actions.name: createFile
actions.description: Save text as a new file.

actions.name: change_file_encoding
actions.description: Convert a file from one text encoding to another.

actions.name: checkFileType
actions.description: Detect a file's type and check it against the one you pick.

actions.name: zipFiles
actions.description: Bundle one or more files into a zip archive.

actions.name: unzipFile
actions.description: Extract every file inside a zip archive.

actions.name: get_file_name
actions.description: Return a file's name, including its extension.
